description:
Purpose and Impact: ( a write up about the program that will attract candidates ) 
 Our Full-Stack Developers work in a dynamic, mission-driven environment to develop geolocation capabilities, adapting to changing priorities that directly support the warfighter. In this role, you will create service-oriented architectures in Java and microservice solutions, and build web interfaces. You will participate in the full lifecycle of your code, from translating requirements into user stories, through integration and testing, to deployment and Tier 3 support.  
 Work Schedule: (shift hours and days of the week) 
 5 Days/ 8 hours per day
 Essential Responsibilities: ( describe the day-to-day ) 
 Perform software development predominantly using Java to create and implement enhancements to existing capabilities 
 Collaborate with software and systems engineers in an agile environment to analyze requirements and derive user stories for development planning 
 Perform integration and testing as needed 
 Test and debug code for integrated applications 
 Leverage SI to debug code, conduct code reviews, and improve code quality and efficiency 
 Provide Tier 3 support for deployed capabilities and address bug fixes 
 Communicate and collaborate effectively with other team members, as well as with stakeholders 
 Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands: 
   
 Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities): 
 Experience with Enterprise Java development (versions 17 or higher)
 Experience with Java application frameworks, such as Spring Boot
 Experience with messaging frameworks such as JMS, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, ZeroMQ, and supporting data formats such as JSON, XML, and Google Protocol Buffers
 Experience developing service-oriented architectures
 Experience developing micro service solutions
 Database experience such as Mongo or MySQL
 Experience analyzing requirement, creating use cases, and test cases and tracking work using the Atlassian tool suite (Jira/Confluence)
 DevOps experience including managing CI/CD pipelines to automate building, testing, and deploying code utilizing GitLab runners
 Experience implementing 508 Compliance requirements to user interfaces
 Familiarity with or willingness to perform agentic coding
 Ability to leverage SI to debug code, conduct code reviews, improve code quality and efficiency, and determine root-cause analysis
 Experience with Python development
 Ability to work individually or as part of a team and shift between priority tasks as directed
   
 Security Clearance Required: 
 TS//SCI w FSP - Maryland 
 Minimum Education: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. 
 Four (4) years of additional SWE experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree. 
 Minimum Years of Experience: 
 Twenty (20) years’ experience as a SWE in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required. 
 Required Certifications: (if needed) 
 Preferred Qualifications: AI if applicable to your program 
 Experience with Java development IDEs (e.g. IntelliJ, Eclipse, VS Code)
 Experience/knowledge with installations and configuration utilizing Kubernetes, Docker Compose and Nifi
 Experience with Elasticsearch
 Experience with geolocation applications and/or JICD
 Experience/knowledge of ISLANDTRANSPORT, messaging infrastructure
 Exposure to/basic familiarity with Python libraries for scientific programming (examples: NumPy, pandas) desired
 Ability to read and write into/out of the data structures adjacent to complex mathematics
  
 Additional Hashtags: 
 #javelin
        
 Compensation Details: 
$236,000 - $264,000        
 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.
  
 Benefits Overview: 
 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:
 Health, dental, and vision insurance

 Paid time off and holidays

 Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

 Educational reimbursement

 Parental leave

 Employee stock purchase plan

 Tax-saving options

 Disability and life insurance

 Pet insurance

  
 Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits. 
        
 Original Posting: 
10/30/2026 - Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs.
